🚨 A 6-year-old girl was rescued alive after spending approximately 55 to 60 hours trapped beneath flood debris in Timure, Rasuwa District, Nepal. Members of Nepal’s Armed Police Force worked through mud and wreckage before reaching the child, identified in reports as Manisha, and safely pulling her from the destruction. 🙏 The girl received immediate medical assistance and was reportedly transferred to Kathmandu for further care. Information about her parents remained unclear following the rescue, which has become a powerful moment of hope amid the devastating floods that have claimed numerous lives across Nepal. #Nepal #Rasuwa #Rescue #Floods #SurvivalStory

Wildest Festival Yet 🤯🐮 Only in Nepal will you find a festival to do with people passing away, cows, dancing, cross dressing and loads more.  Welcome to Gai Jatra - which literally translates to cow festival.  There’s a huge historical story behind it which is too long to explain here but essentially people originally took cows through the street as a way of saying  final goodbye to their loved ones but now for practicality they use these giant effigies call Tahamacha.  Hospitality of Nepal is off to a fantastic start absolutely loving it here but it feels like there is a festival everyday in Nepal - full video on this will be out on the Youchooobz at some point.  #nepaltiktok #nepal #kathmandu #gaijatra

Une impressionnante coulée de boue et de débris aurait frappé une zone montagneuse du Népal, provoquant une vague destructrice dans un environnement traversé par une rivière, selon les informations présentées dans la vidéo. Les images montrent une importante masse d’eau chargée de terre et de rochers dévalant la vallée, tandis que plusieurs personnes tentent de s’éloigner rapidement de la zone. Ce type de phénomène, souvent associé aux fortes précipitations, aux glissements de terrain ou à la rupture d’un barrage naturel, peut détruire des routes, des ponts et des habitations en quelques instants. La hauteur de 40 mètres annoncée dans la vidéo et l’ampleur des dégâts ne sont toutefois pas confirmées par cette seule capture, qui ne permet pas non plus d’établir le bilan humain. #actualite #France #info #Nepal #inondation

Full cost breakdown of an Everest Basecamp Trek x Mera Peak Expedition 💰 A few useful details if you’re planning the same expedition: Trekking operator: MountainTreksNepal -> handled all logistics for a 27 day expedition Travel insurance: @True Traveller –> I used them for my high-altitude cover, medical treatment and helicopter evacuation. Really impressed with how they handled everything. Biggest expense: The £2,300 expedition package, which included accommodation, meals, guides, porter, permits, duffel bag, sleeping bag, and domestic flights. A few things to budget extra for: snacks, WiFi, device charging, equipment rental and tips. Prices increase significantly as you gain altitude. Save this if you’re planning an Everest Base Camp or Mera Peak expedition! 🔖

November 14, 2026 Gorkha District, Nepal A large dry landslide occurred in Gorkha District. A mass of earth and rock collapsed from the Gundrung Pakha slope into the Thado Bharyang forest area near Yarubagar. Rocks began falling as early as Friday night, and the main landslide took place around 8:30 a.m., kicking up a massive cloud of dust. Debris reached the Budhi Gandaki River. The landslide blocked both a motorable road and a foot trail. According to the district police, there were no casualties or material damage.
